purpose: Validate retaining already-confirmed unchanged messages through menu-only transitions, before production integration
messageGate: A filled menu cursor never by itself confirms a new message. Existing genuine message-complete/fading state, a down arrow in the main message box, or 100ms of unchanged message fields confirms it; keep the confirmation only while the current message signature is unchanged.
menuGate: Menu-only pages retain v18 rules. Mixed pages expose menuReady and messageReady separately. Existing redraw/scroll/clear states remain ineligible.
pcSuspensionGate: On a currently identified pc_prompt, a hollow parent selection in renderer column1 with no active child selection to its right blocks message publication until a main-message arrow, active child or changed context is observed. Source-backed PC item-operation semantics, not clip identity or wording.
negativeControl: Blanket suppression of all hollow-only menus is deliberately compared to expose loss of legitimate merchant messages; it is not the selected rule.
signature: Message readingOrder is relative to the message-only channel; message-region marks and message-area detached marks are included. Whole-candidate signature remains unchanged.
observationClock: Original integer PTS; no future or between-frame timer events; reset at existing clip boundary with real warmup
residualFalseTrigger: Same frozen loading/message_loading definition as previous comparison
pageDetection: Same116 frozen page opportunities and strict-key raw/final text scores as previous comparison; all duplicate observations must be ready
shortPage: Same complete-frame duration strictly below200ms; do not discard or extend short pages
delay: Source-PTS readiness lower bound only, not actual UI latency; misses excluded from quantiles and reported separately
boundaries: Never read GT, clip/frame IDs, fixed messages or future observations in a policy. No GT/scorer/OCR changes; all previous production repair limits remain. This is development evidence, not independent acceptance.
history: Retain only an existing confirmation through enumerated non-message menu transitions. Never emit in those states or confirm a fresh message there. Message scrolling/clearing, absence, content/position/mark changes, reset or nonmonotonic/changed clocks revoke it.
